sentiment.label: risk_off
sentiment.reason_it: Il VIX a 19.30 (+3.21%) indica un mercato difensivo, mentre l'S&P 500 è sceso del -0.40% a 7,561.67, segnalando pressione ribassista. Il DXY a 103.46 (+0.05%) resta forte, penalizzando gli asset rischiosi. Il TLT 20Y è in calo del -0.43% (tassi in rialzo) e il Brent sale a $96.60 (+0.79%) ma l'inflazione rimane sopra le attese (CPI USA 4.1%). Le view istituzionali di BlackRock (outlook risk‑off) e Goldman Sachs (cautela su equity) confermano il tono bearish. Geopoliticamente non emergono conflitti attivi, quindi il contributo è neutro.
sentiment.reason_en: The VIX at 19.30 (+3.21%) points to a defensive market, while the S&P 500 fell -0.40% to 7,561.67, indicating downside pressure. The DXY at 103.46 (+0.05%) stays strong, hurting risk assets. The 20‑year TLT dropped -0.43% (rising rates) and Brent rose to $96.60 (+0.79%) but inflation stays above expectations (US CPI 4.1%). BlackRock's risk‑off outlook and Goldman Sachs' cautious equity stance reinforce the bearish tone. No active wars are reported, so the geopolitical contribution is neutral.

market_impact_summary.it: Equity: S&P 500 -0.40% e STOXX 600 +0.05% mostrano divergenza, con la pressione del DXY forte (103.46) che penalizza i risk‑on. Fixed income: TLT -0.43% e US 10Y a 5.15% (+1.00%) confermano la compressione dei titoli a lungo termine. Commodities: Brent +0.79% a $96.60, oro -0.92% a $3,850.50 (mixed). Il VIX in lieve aumento (19.30) spinge verso un asset allocation più difensiva. Le analisi settimanali di BlackRock e Goldman Sachs sottolineano un outlook risk‑off, in linea con i dati macro recenti.
market_impact_summary.en: Equities: S&P 500 -0.40% and STOXX 600 +0.05% show divergence, with a strong DXY (103.46) weighing on risk‑on assets. Fixed income: TLT -0.43% and US 10Y at 5.15% (+1.00%) confirm long‑bond compression. Commodities: Brent +0.79% at $96.60, gold -0.92% at $3,850.50 (mixed). The VIX rise to 19.30 nudges the market toward defensive positioning. Weekly BlackRock and Goldman Sachs reports highlight a risk‑off outlook, consistent with recent macro data.
